::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 3\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 15 minutes

[Side]{.badge .badge-side} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*I've never seen anyone eat just one of these.*

## Ingredients

- 6 hard-boiled eggs
- ¼ cup mayonnaise
- 1½ tbsp sweet pickle relish
- 1 tsp mustard
- ⅛ tsp salt
- dash of black pepper
- sprinkle of paprika

## Instructions

*Pre-boil the eggs for 10–12 minutes and allow to cool completely.*

1. Slice the eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove the yolks.
2. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise.
3. Add the relish, mustard, salt, and pepper; stir well.
4. Spoon the yolk mixture back into the egg whites.
5. Sprinkle with paprika.
